scope_note: Source pages and local task metadata were inspected. These records are not downloaded, built, novelty-cleared, difficulty-calibrated or accepted task instances.

selection_policy.unit: candidate = pinned source unit + coherent proposed work package + original task anchor + validation contract
acquisition_order: documented source revision or dataset release
hard_gates: source and task-material reuse terms checked
same mechanism and matching semantic constraints
selection_policy.ranking_note: Use separate similarity, novelty, validity, cost and difficulty evidence. Do not replace hard gates with one embedding similarity score.
novelty_checks: source lineage, fork and copy detection
normalized theorem goals and proof dependencies
selection_policy.permitted_shared_assets: Infrastructure, standard libraries, engines and foundational mathematics may be shared; target task material and answers require independent provenance.
selection_policy.split_unit: Group related tasks by source lineage, dataset entities, theorem/project clusters or scene families before train/development/evaluation splitting.
selection_policy.original_visibility_limit: Only 51 public task definitions are locally indexed. Most full task assets remain inside unextracted images; 83 paper-index-only tasks cannot receive high-confidence matching from titles alone.
selection_policy.model_policy: Proposed source-inspection, construction and blind-solve agents use gpt-6.1-sol in separate contexts. This registry launches no agents.
selection_policy.final_holdout_policy: Construction and calibration use author QA and development evidence; frozen final evaluation contents and answers are never returned to the constructor.
selection_policy.validation_note: Novelty against accessible benchmark assets is a bounded claim, not proof of absence from model pretraining.

candidates.observed_capability: OpenAPI-driven stateful REST API testing with request dependencies and replayable bug reports.
candidates.candidate_unit: One coherent feature bundle spanning request generation, state propagation and reporting in a pinned revision.
novelty_required: independent source lineage from Schemathesis
new feature dependency graph
new local API fixtures and target behavior
blocking_checks: Inspect original full task instructions and graders, not only task metadata.
Build RESTler and local fixtures offline in an isolated environment.
Identify a feature bundle comparable in scope; language and toolchain changes need separate calibration.
Check copied code, test and patch lineage against original task assets.

candidates.observed_capability: Distributed version control with a public development repository and command documentation.
candidates.candidate_unit: A selected, interacting set of local version-control commands and persistent repository behavior.
similarity_to_preserve: output, exit-code and filesystem differential tests
novelty_required: different reference application and storage semantics
new histories and operation sequences
blocking_checks: Select scope against original Git task rather than attempting an unbounded full rewrite.
Pin source revision and build a reference executable.
Verify local-only commands and deterministic comparison.
Audit source, behavior fixtures and answers for overlap.

candidates.observed_capability: YUV scaling, pixel-format conversion and architecture-specific optimized implementations.
candidates.candidate_unit: A bounded conversion/scaling API surface with an independently built reference, a correct slow starter and a new workload distribution.
novelty_required: new target API and reference implementation
new required function combinations
new image contents and shape/stride cases
blocking_checks: Check shared algorithms, copied kernels and fixture lineage; a different repository name is insufficient.
Freeze pixel rounding and border semantics.
Independently establish measurement stability and a useful performance gap.
Match source visibility, editable scope, hardware and time budgets to the anchor.

candidates.observed_capability: Official cutting-and-packing dataset catalogue points to the ESICUP/datasets repository.
candidates.candidate_unit: Previously unused 2D irregular strip-packing shape families plus a calibrated optimizer engineering task.
novelty_required: new underlying shapes and source families
new engineering starting point or substantive optimization target
blocking_checks: Extract original jagua-rs benchmark assets before excluding overlap.
Check dimensions, rotation, holes, clearance and objective compatibility.
Canonicalize polygons up to relevant rigid transformations and permutations.
Changing only hidden shapes in the same engineering setup is case expansion, not independent task diversity.

candidates.observed_capability: Extended VRPTW benchmark; inspected 1000-customer documentation describes hierarchical vehicle-count/distance objectives and double-precision distances.
candidates.candidate_unit: Generation-method and parameter-profile reference, not a directly admitted same-distribution replacement for Solomon-100.
novelty_required: no original Solomon point sets or route answers
blocking_checks: Larger customer counts change scale and runtime profile.
Published distance conventions differ from the rounded metric in the current EdgeBench task.
Do not label raw larger cases as distribution-matched.
Any size reduction changes the data distribution and requires independent validation.

candidates.observed_capability: A documented three-dimensional dissolved-constituent transport example with analytical-solution references.
candidates.candidate_unit: A fresh finite-release transport scene, well layout and observation set using a validated forward model.
novelty_required: new physical scene and latent parameters
new monitoring layout and observations
no copied original concentration field
blocking_checks: The linked forward example is not itself an equivalent inverse task.
Confirm governing equations, boundary conditions, source parameterization and public information are compatible.
Validate numerical error and identifiability.
Check overlap with the original Borden reproduction and keep the hidden forward model author-side.

candidates.observed_capability: Gravity forward-modelling tools; related Choclo documentation identifies collaboration with SimPEG.
candidates.candidate_unit: New 3D density geometry and observation scenario supporting a comparable regularized inversion engineering task.
novelty_required: new density model and measurement provenance
new research scenario, not a renamed Vinton example
blocking_checks: A forward-model library alone is not a complete task source.
Shared numerical kernels mean two library names do not prove independent numerical verification.
Inspect the original D-ABIC requirements before choosing methods and deliverables.
Reconstruct an independently validated reference and computational budget.

candidates.observed_capability: Node-prediction datasets with documented graphs, labels, splits and metrics.
candidates.candidate_unit: A previously unused graph/domain with the same prediction setting and a budget-compatible training task.
similarity_to_preserve: base-PyTorch and CPU constraints if required by the original
novelty_required: new underlying graph and entity provenance
non-overlapping source records rather than merely new node split indices
blocking_checks: Identify the original hidden dataset first; OGB may already be its source.
Match homogeneous/heterogeneous graph assumptions, label type and transductive/inductive setting.
Large OGB graphs are not automatically compatible with the original CPU budget.
Record entity and connected-subgraph overlap; subgraph sampling is not an automatic novelty guarantee.

candidates.observed_capability: Lists established mathematical formalization projects and separate early-stage project intentions.
candidates.candidate_unit: A completed, kernel-checked theorem dependency subgraph in the matching mathematical subfield.
novelty_required: new target theorems and proof dependency subgraph
no renamed or re-exported original theorem goals
blocking_checks: Exclude original projects, duplicated targets and renamed/re-exported declarations.
Shared foundational mathlib dependencies are permitted but must not expose target results.
Project intentions and incomplete proofs are not reference solutions.
Check normalized propositions, imports, axioms and exact Lean/library versions.

candidates.observed_capability: Published factor and portfolio-return datasets with documented construction and time frequencies.
candidates.candidate_unit: A separately sourced research case with comparable instruments, information availability, objective and required deliverables.
similarity_to_preserve: portfolio or strategy evaluation only where the full anchor requires it
novelty_required: new asset/entity and time provenance
new research question and material package, not renamed instruments
blocking_checks: Obtain the original full task instructions; one anchor is currently paper-index-only locally.
Portfolio-return series cannot substitute for security-level prices or futures if those are required.
Check data reuse/training terms and underlying data lineage.
Use time/entity-aware splits and information-at-the-time constraints.
Do not infer near-distribution status from the shared finance category.

candidates.observed_capability: Downloadable version-specific add-ons of multiple types, including campaigns and multiplayer content.
candidates.candidate_unit: New compatible multiplayer tactical scenarios with unchanged decision API and comparable victory conditions.
novelty_required: new authored map topology and scenario structure
no renamed, rotated or resampled original map
blocking_checks: Filter out content whose single-player quest rules change the original task mechanism.
Inspect per-add-on assets and reuse terms.
Canonicalize map geometry and unit/setup provenance.
Check reachability, balance, default-bot performance and reward stability.

candidates.observed_capability: Interactive-fiction archive includes multiple interpreter formats and source code for many games.
candidates.candidate_unit: An independently authored, inspectable parser-based game with a comparable puzzle dependency structure and observable progress.
novelty_required: new game, narrative and puzzle graph
no port, remake, translation or renamed original game
blocking_checks: Inspect game-specific source availability and training/reuse terms.
Exclude incompatible browser-only or multiple-choice interfaces when matching parser-game anchors.
Keep walkthroughs and authoritative solutions private.
Verify reproducible progression and comparable dependency depth with actual play.
